question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow plus configurable send shortcut be the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The request is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics and has a clear implementation shape, but it adds a second composition mode with draft, focus, attachment, queue, and keyboard semantics that should be chosen by a Control UI owner before automation implements it.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Add a bounded modal editor in the chat composer with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and UI tests for modal keyboard behavior.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer Only
options.body: Close or narrow this request if maintainers decide the current autogrow textarea and modifier-send setting are the supported long-prompt workflow.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but leave it out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Add a bounded modal editor in the chat composer with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and UI tests for modal keyboard behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent review and current-main ownership trail for the send-shortcut behavior and prior issue triage.
